description: Geopolitical leaders, officials, and institutions monitored for market-moving posts across influence platforms (TruthSocial and X/Twitter). Each person carries an active_from date (power/influence start -- the FIRST-term election/inauguration date for continuously-serving leaders (so their whole tenure is captured, not just the current term), otherwise the election date since a president-elect dominates the Nov->inauguration transition gap; N/A if appointed / monarch / not elected) and expiration_date (the NEXT election date = when the rank-0 primary switches to the winner; N/A if no competitive term). The rank-0 primary is listed under primary_accounts and SWITCHES to the election winner ON election day, not at inauguration. Entities rank-1 is reserved for the current cycle's leading challenger; during an election period the two leading candidates BOTH occupy rank-1 with equal weight (uncertain outcome = both maximally market-moving), collapsing to a single rank-0 winner on election day. Entities rank-2 is reserved for the challenger's BACKER / successor-in-power -- the incumbent endorsing a successor, or a VP who ascends on the president's death/incapacity and backs the nominee; their endorsement partially transfers influence to the rank-1 nominee (successor_of).
source: truth_social.csv (spaCy NER PERSON extraction over 7333 posts)

primary_accounts.name: Donald J. Trump
primary_accounts.note: Rank-0 primary influence account; 47th U.S. President. Elected 2024-11-05; rank-0 switches to the next election's winner ON election day 2028-11-07 (president-elect dominates the Nov->Jan transition gap), NOT at the 2029-01-20 inauguration. Rank-0 is assigned to whoever holds the primary influence position.

entities.name: RESERVED -- leading election challenger / nominee
entities.note: Held for the current cycle's leading challenger to the rank-0 primary. Platform is N/A until the challenger is known: Republicans post mainly on Truth Social, Democrats and most foreign leaders on X/Twitter -- set platform + account/twitter_handle when the nominee emerges. During an election period the challenger sits here at rank-1 with weight EQUAL to the rank-0 primary (two co-equal accounts, outcome uncertain); on election day the winner becomes sole rank-0 and the loser moves to archives (active_to = election day). Vladimir Putin previously held rank 1 -- moved to excluded (no official X account).

entities.name: RESERVED -- nominee's backer / successor-in-power
entities.note: Held for whoever throws power behind the rank-1 nominee: normally the sitting president endorsing a successor (e.g. Trump -> Ivanka), or -- if the president dies / is incapacitated -- the VP who ascends and rules temporarily (e.g. JD Vance) and backs that nominee. The backer's endorsement partially transfers influence to the rank-1 nominee (successor_of link). Set platform + account/twitter_handle when the backer is known. Xi Jinping previously held rank 2 -- moved to excluded (no official X account).

archives.description: Out-of-office / former accounts, archived office handles, and past election nominees. NOT fetched on default runs -- x_tweets_retriever.py includes these only when --handles is given, and ignores their expiry so historical tweets can be backfilled. active_from = when the account became market-relevant (election/office start, or campaign start for nominees); active_to = when relevance ended (term end, ban, death, or election-day loss). For election nominees, peak_date marks election day, when influence is hottest.
